name: Lost for Words

angles.text: As a fellow Forsaken, you understand what it means to hold your frame together when limbs and jaws can be torn away in battle.
As a druid, facing one of your own calling among the Grimtotem is a stark reminder that nature's power can be bent to violence.

faq.answer: Blaise Montgomery is a Forsaken resting at Camp Mojache who lost his lower jaw in a fight with Grimtotem tauren.
Namida is a Grimtotem druid leading a camp to the northwest, responsible for the attack on Blaise Montgomery.
He lost his lower jaw in an ambush by Grimtotem attackers, forcing him to write his thoughts on paper instead of speaking.
faq.q: Why is Blaise Montgomery unable to speak?

faq.answer: Her camp lies to the northwest of Camp Mojache.
faq.q: Where is the Grimtotem camp located?

faq.answer: He asks for proof that the Grimtotem druid Namida has been slain, seeking vengeance for his lost jaw.

sections.body: At Camp Mojache, a Forsaken named Blaise Montgomery cannot speak. A violent skirmish with Grimtotem tauren cost him his lower jaw, leaving him only scraps of paper to scrawl his thoughts. His note names a druid named Namida as the leader of the raiders from a camp to the northwest. He wants her to pay for what she took.
sections.title: A Scrawled Vengeance

summary: At Camp Mojache, Blaise Montgomery hands you a scrawled note instead of speaking, having lost his lower jaw to Grimtotem raiders. A druid named Namida led the assault from the northwest, and he demands vengeance for what he suffered.
attribution: In-game quest text: Lost for Words
